SELECT 
  signup_date,
  date_trunc('WEEK', signup_date) as dt_week,
  cast(date_trunc('WEEK', signup_date) as DATE) as dt_week_date,
  dayofweek(signup_date) as dow,
  date_sub(signup_date, (dayofweek(signup_date) + 5) % 7) as monday_sub
FROM workspace.exam_x5e37e.signups
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  min(signup_date), max(signup_date), count(distinct user_id), count(*)
FROM workspace.exam_x5e37e.signups

SELECT 
  datediff(DATE '2026-08-10', DATE '2026-08-03') as d1,
  floor(datediff(DATE '2026-08-10', DATE '2026-08-03') / 7) as w1,
  floor(datediff(DATE '2026-08-09', DATE '2026-08-03') / 7) as w0,
  floor(datediff(DATE '2026-08-03', DATE '2026-08-03') / 7) as w00,
  datediff(DATE '2026-08-02', DATE '2026-08-03') as d_neg

SELECT 
  cast(date_trunc('WEEK', signup_date) as DATE) AS cohort_week,
  count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size,
  count(*) as total_rows
FROM workspace.exam_x5e37e.signups
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  round(100.0 * 5 / 73, 1) as r1,
  typeof(round(100.0 * 5 / 73, 1)) as t1,
  round(100 * 5 / 73.0, 1) as r2,
  typeof(round(100 * 5.0 / 73, 1)) as t2

WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    cast(date_trunc('WEEK', signup_date) as DATE) AS cohort_week,
    user_id,
    signup_date
  FROM workspace.exam_x5e37e.signups
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    count(distinct user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM cohorts
  GROUP BY cohort_week
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT explode(sequence(0, 4)) AS week_n
),
cohort_grid AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.cohort_week,
    cs.cohort_size,
    w.week_n
  FROM cohort_sizes cs
  CROSS JOIN weeks w
),
user_activity_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.cohort_week,
    c.user_id,
    cast(floor(datediff(a.activity_date, c.signup_date) / 7) as INT) AS week_n
  FROM cohorts c
  JOIN workspace.exam_x5e37e.activity a
    ON c.user_id = a.user_id
  WHERE a.activity_date >= c.signup_date
    AND floor(datediff(a.activity_date, c.signup_date) / 7) BETWEEN 0 AND 4
),
cohort_week_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_week,
    week_n,
    count(distinct user_id) AS active_users
  FROM user_activity_weeks
  GROUP BY cohort_week, week_n
)
SELECT 
  cg.cohort_week,
  cg.cohort_size,
  cg.week_n,
  coalesce(cwa.active_users, 0) AS active_users,
  round(100.0 * coalesce(cwa.active_users, 0) / cg.cohort_size, 1) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort_grid cg
LEFT JOIN cohort_week_activity cwa
  ON cg.cohort_week = cwa.cohort_week
  AND cg.week_n = cwa.week_n
ORDER BY cg.cohort_week, cg.week_n
